text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh, why if it isn't Trainer

<username>! Good
job
today.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I was actually just meeting with some
academy
officials about a future concert
event.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And well... you could say force of habit
brought
me to this training center.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
How nostalgic... I had my fair share of
difficult
times, but I made a lot of good
memories here,
too.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, be sure to work hard with your
trainee so
that you can watch her
perform many winning
concerts, okay?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and leave stage direction to me! I'll
do my
best to create the grandest
spectacle!
